title: Filter
text: Model RF Filter, {Filter type} sets Filter type; {Design method} sets the simulation type, {Implementation}, {Passband edge frequency}, {Implement using filter order}, {Filter order}, {Passband frequency}, {Passband frequencies}, {Passband attenuation (dB)} sets the passband attenuation 10*log10, {Stopband frequencies}, {Stopband attenuation (dB)}, {Source impedance (Ohm)} sets the input source resistance, {Load impedance (Ohm)} sets the output load resistance, {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals, {Export} sets the save filter design, {Parameter 1} sets the type of plots on y-axis, {Parameter 2} sets the type of plots, {Format 1} sets the scaling of y-axis Magnitude, {Format 2} sets the scaling of y-axis Magnitude, {Frequency points}, {X-axis scale} and {Y-axis scale}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Design method
params.values: Simulation type Butterworth (default) | Chebyshev | Inverse Chebyshev | Ideal

params.name: Filter type
params.values: Filter type Lowpass (default) | Highpass | Bandpass | Bandstop

params.name: Implementation
params.values: Implementation LC Tee | LC Pi | Transfer function | Constant per carrier | Frequency Domain

params.name: Passband edge frequency
params.values: Passband edge frequency 1 GHz (default) | scalar

params.name: Implement using filter order
params.values: Implement using filter order off (default) | on

params.name: Filter order
params.values: Filter order 3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Passband frequency
params.values: Passband frequency for lowpass and highpass filters scalar

params.name: Passband frequencies
params.values: Passband frequencies for bandpass filters [2 3] GHz (default) | 2-tuple vector

params.name: Passband attenuation (dB)
params.values: Passband attenuation 10*log10(2) (default) | scalar

params.name: Stopband frequencies
params.values: Stopband frequencies for bandstop filters [2.1 2.9] GHz (default) | 2-tuple vector

params.name: Stopband attenuation (dB)
params.values: Stopband attenuation 40 (default) | scalar

params.name: Source impedance (Ohm)
params.values: Input source resistance 50 (default) | scalar

params.name: Load impedance (Ohm)
params.values: Output load resistance 50 (default) | scalar

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off

params.name: Export
params.values: Save filter design to a file button

params.name: Parameter 1
params.values: Type of plots on y-axis Voltage transfer (default) | Phase delay | Group delay

params.name: Parameter 2
params.values: Type of plots None (default) | Voltage transfer | Phase delay | Group delay

params.name: Format 1
params.values: Scaling of y-axis Magnitude (decibels) (default) | Magnitude (linear) | Angle (degrees) | Real | Imaginary

params.name: Format 2
params.values: Scaling of y-axis Magnitude (decibels) (default) | Magnitude (linear) | Angle (degrees) | Real | Imaginary

params.name: Frequency points
params.values: Frequency points to plot on x-axis logspace(0,10,101) Hz (default) | vector

params.name: X-axis scale
params.values: X-axis scale Linear (default) | Logarithmic

params.name: Y-axis scale
params.values: Y-axis scale Linear (default) | Logarithmic
